source_evidence:
PLAY-REC-D277-CAER-VEYLAN-SPLIT-VISITS-001
Player actual instruction from Day277 morning at Copper Hearth after two-room corrected bill/rest: "Lets split up and meet back here at night. Everyone goes does their own thing that they are interested in. V goes to Keld household and Harrow & Pike to see if theres anything new developed." This authorizes DAY277 independent daylight excursions, not V joining any new job, spending limited abilities/coin, or accepting a convoy automatically. At morning breakfast the four agree to return to Copper Hearth by night. Mara independently chooses public old survey stones and artisans/historians; Cirren independently travels to public Freight Exchange for Eastwatch route roadbook/news; Fenar independently watches public disciplined Veyran garrison training and eats/explores at ordinary food/arts quarter; each acts separately, not magically informed of other's events, all later reports grounded in their own observations. Owned four healthy horses, coach and baggage remain at Copper Hearth; no new stable booking/fee or new city overnight.
V visits established Keld household MIDMORNING, old caretaker Garrick Voss willing to receive a returning visitor and consult secured identity register and two original authentication discs, all returned after original Day22 copying for 50gp. Garrick recognizes V and sword; privately reports no subsequently discovered household-origin authenticated genealogical material proving V's claimed ancestry, does not promise ancestry verdict, secret seal, proof of signet ownership or disclose DM lore. He mentions neutral acknowledgement to earlier Day151 correspondence, actually received at Blackthorn by Day166 but unread by V there; V now learns his general nonproof position directly without claiming letter was opened. Garrick remains a professional custodian and offers actual future comparison of specific newly obtained independently verifiable evidence with originals; no magical item or record custody changes, no new fee, or implied acceptance.
V visits established freight brokerage Harrow & Pike EARLY AFTERNOON, whose original Day24–26 inquiry included Veyran Directorate inspector Darya Kess, with NO imposed travel ban in accepted history. A senior shipping clerk checks own commercial records and truthfully reports no later company-received travel prohibition, seizure or new formal demand concerning V's old inquiry as of Day277. Does NOT claim to know or close hidden Directorate case files, create an exoneration or reveal classified details, or presume inspector Kess present. Company ordinary eastbound freight business continues; independent planned consignment west Caer Veylan→Eastwatch corridor leaves MORNING Day278 under own dispatch, optional possibility to approach actual drivers for permission to travel alongside for an agreed arrangement. No V contract, fee, caravan acceptance, guarantee of route safety, proprietary manifests access or travel committed. No location/day correction.
By ~Day277 19:00 reunion at Copper Hearth: Mara's own notes show old road boundary markers from multiple administrations, copied inscriptions in her journal, NOT proof of Silver Court or V genealogy; Cirren has ordinary usable Eastwatch trade staging/road note sheet, reports maintained eastern route open, not guaranteed risk-free or exact miles; Fenar has observed skilled garrison shield formations in public, admires tactical discipline without endorsing Veyran regime, visited food arcade, no fighting, rage or forced spending. No outside quests triggered or accepted, no covert meeting, spell, die, injury or personal money expenditure; no Day278 dawn, new meal/night-rest charge or resupply consumption. Current V HP48/48 HD7/7 full MP7/7, Psi6/6, Superiority4/4 and ActionSurge/SecondWind etc, Cirren51/51 HD6/6 full spell slots, Fenar59/59 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6, Mara healthy; purse975gp9sp6cp, supplies21 ration-person-days and28 feed animal-days, sole sealed Pixie Dust unused, four owned horses and coach healthy. Long Rest completed Day277 dawn and new cycle weighted0/6. Player decision at reunion: remain in city, pursue actual document comparison, seek Day278 caravan consent or depart independently to Eastwatch; no pending answer assigned.
pending_action: Day277 ~7 PM Copper Hearth common room in Caer Veylan, V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar regroup after independent day. V saw Garrick Voss at Keld (no newly verified ancestral proof; originals retained, future evidence comparison offered) and Harrow & Pike (old Darya Kess freight inquiry no company-side new demands/travel prohibition, private Directorate status unknown; independent company eastbound consignment planned dawn/morning Day278 with potential driver's consent for alongside travel). Mara saw historic survey stones, no V ancestry match; Cirren collected common eastbound roadbook advice; Fenar watched Commonwealth drill and artisans, no combat. V48/48 HP HD7/7 full resources, Cirren51/51 HD6/6 full slots, Fenar59/59 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6, Mara healthy. V purse975gp9sp6cp, 21 ration-person-days/28 horse-feed animal-days, intact coach and four healthy horses at inn, one sealed Pixie Dust unused; LongRest new cycle0/6 after dawn277. No evening inn/supper payment or overnight rest since reunion; awaits V's choice city visit, discussion or next-day Eastwatch travel/caravan inquiry. Do not silently accept paid convoy or add family proof.
